descriptions.notStarted: You should talk to #b#p1202005##k, standing on the road to town.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1202005# confesses that he's always wanted to build one particular gift for a hero and that he's stored all the necessary components in a box. He asks you to break open the box and bring him the items inside. Break boxes by swinging at them with regular attacks, then collect the #b#t4032309##k and #b#t4032310##k.
descriptions.completed: You received a chair from #p1202005#. #p1202005# encouraged you by telling you that you are still a hero even though you've lost your powers.
